description: Source-bound QIK-VRT bootstrap and verified native Linux x86_64, macOS arm64 and Windows Server 2025 AMD64 packages; SQLite/TEMDD, Pharo 13.1 Linux and an emulated MC68000 Linux-ABI witness. Includes original sources, exact licenses, binaries and scoped execution evidence. Reassemble the 29 numbered parts according to BUNDLE_PARTS.json. This version does not establish Windows 11, physical MC68000, a complete archived OCI appliance, or universal independence from all other software. QIK-VRT code remains PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0; documentation CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0; historical and third-party licenses remain unchanged. See included notices for component rights.
title: Universales Raumzeit-Terminal: source-bound bootstrap and verified runtime variants
